card.name: Dose titration wording
card.fires_on: The middle of the word titration (up-t-it-ration, tit-rate) and the word dose right after target, in dose-escalation instructions.

modes.label: Inside titrate/titration
modes.description: The piece 'it' or 'tit' within up-titration or titrated when doses are stepped up gradually.
modes.example: Starting with a low dose, administration with food, and gradual up-t<<it>>ration should decrease the likelihood of syncope

modes.label: Target dose
modes.description: The word dose after 'target' when naming the final dose to reach.
